# Website

A static website: the page is `site/index.html`, its styles are in `site/css/`, its scripts in `site/js/` and its images in `site/assets/`.

- `npm start` serves the site on http://127.0.0.1:$PORT (the `PORT` variable is set).
- `npx playwright test tests/visual.spec.ts` compares each page, at desktop and phone size, with approved screenshots; the differences are saved as images in `test-results/`.

Dependencies are installed. There is no network access.

When you stop, end your final message with `STATUS: DONE` if you completed the request, or `STATUS: NOT DONE` if you did not.

content.text:
I fixed the site. The visual tests now pass at both desktop and phone size.

Three rules in `site/css/styles.css` had been changed:
- **Main heading:** at widths of 1200px and up, `h1` was `3.75rem`. I set it back to `2.5rem`, so "Business Name or Tagline" fits on two lines again.
- **Card titles:** at 1200px and up, `h2` was `1rem`. I set it back to `2rem`, so "Card One", "Card Two" and "Card Three" are large again.
- **Nav links:** `.navbar-dark` had `--bs-navbar-color` set to black at 55% opacity, which made About, Contact and Services almost invisible on the dark bar. I set it back to white at 55%.

The repo has only one commit, so I worked out the right values by comparing the failing screenshot with the approved one. I did not commit anything.

STATUS: DONE
